This dataset compiles education-related metrics for 30 countries spanning Europe, Asia, the Americas, and Oceania. It pairs public education spending with three outcome dimensions — academic performance, tertiary access, and youth labor market integration — to enable cross-country comparison.

- Gross enrollment rates can exceed 100% due to inclusion of students outside the typical age cohort.

- Youth unemployment definitions follow ILO standards but national measurement practices may vary slightly.

import numpy as np

from matplotlib.colors import Normalize
from matplotlib import cm

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Merge all datasets by country
spending = {d['country']: d for d in data['education_spending']['data']}
pisa = {d['country']: d for d in data['pisa_scores']['data']}
tertiary = {d['country']: d for d in data['tertiary_enrollment']['data']}
youth_unemp = {d['country']: d for d in data['youth_unemployment']['data']}

countries = list(spending.keys())

x_vals = [spending[c]['edu_spending_pct_gdp'] for c in countries]
y_vals = [pisa[c]['pisa_avg'] for c in countries]
bubbles = [tertiary[c]['enrollment_rate'] for c in countries]
colors = [youth_unemp[c]['youth_unemp_rate'] for c in countries]
regions = [spending[c]['region'] for c in countries]

# Normalize bubble sizes (scale enrollment 40-110 to 100-800 area)
bubble_min, bubble_max = 40, 110
size_min, size_max = 100, 800
normalized_sizes = [size_min + (size_max - size_min) * (b - bubble_min) / (bubble_max - bubble_min) for b in bubbles]

# Color map for youth unemployment (low = green, high = red)
cmap = cm.RdYlGn_r  # Red-Yellow-Green reversed (high unemployment = red)
norm = Normalize(vmin=min(colors), vmax=max(colors))

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10), dpi=150)

# Professional color scheme - editorial style
fig.patch.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')
ax.set_facecolor('#FAFAFA')

scatter = ax.scatter(x_vals, y_vals, s=normalized_sizes, c=colors, cmap=cmap, norm=norm,
                     alpha=0.75, edgecolors='#333333', linewidths=0.8)

# Add colorbar for youth unemployment
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax, shrink=0.7, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label('Youth Unemployment Rate (% of labor force, ages 15-24)', fontsize=10, labelpad=10)
cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=9)

# Labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Education Spending (% of GDP)', fontsize=12, labelpad=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('PISA Score (avg of reading, math, science)', fontsize=12, labelpad=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Education Investment vs. Outcomes: 30-Country Comparison\n'
            'Bubble size = Tertiary Enrollment Rate | Bubble color = Youth Unemployment Rate',
            fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# Grid styling
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4, color='#CCCCCC')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Highlight notable outliers with labels
outlier_countries = ['Costa Rica', 'Singapore', 'Japan', 'South Korea', 'Spain', 'Italy', 'Sweden', 'Norway', 'Brazil']
for i, country in enumerate(countries):
    if country in outlier_countries:
        ax.annotate(country, (x_vals[i], y_vals[i]),
                   fontsize=8, ha='left', va='bottom',
                   xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points',
                   fontweight='bold',
                   bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='white', edgecolor='#888888', alpha=0.8))

# Legend for bubble size
sizes_legend = [50, 75, 100]
labels_legend = ['50%', '75%', '100%+']
for i, (s, l) in enumerate(zip(sizes_legend, labels_legend)):
    # Convert enrollment rate to size
    size_val = size_min + (size_max - size_min) * (s - bubble_min) / (bubble_max - bubble_min)
    ax.scatter([], [], s=size_val, c='#AAAAAA', alpha=0.6, edgecolors='#333333', linewidths=0.8, label=l)

legend1 = ax.legend(title='Tertiary Enrollment', loc='upper left', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9,
                    framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#888888')
ax.add_artist(legend1)

# Region legend
region_colors = {'Europe': '#2E86AB', 'Asia': '#A23B72', 'Americas': '#F18F01', 'Oceania': '#C73E1D'}
for region, color in region_colors.items():
    ax.scatter([], [], c=color, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='#333333', linewidths=0.8, label=region)

ax.legend(title='Region', loc='lower right', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9,
         framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#888888')

# Tight layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(), edgecolor='none')
plt.close()

print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
